snippet.title: Shop Crush - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at gameplay from Shop Crush in this trailer for the upcoming mysterious shop-owner simulator with psychological horror elements set in the early 2000s. Shop Crush will be available on PC in 2026.
